verdict.rationale: Granola's docs do not show that the product itself extracts action items with owners and collects them in a trackable place. The only explicit mention (granola-docs-53) is an example of what a developer could build with the API, which is a building block, not the capability itself. A community PM reports that action items slip through and that they had to build their own kanban app to track them, which is a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them
